subject: The Higher Flame framework asks what fuel flexibility might change
script: From Agewell Brief: The Higher Flame framework asks what fuel flexibility might change. The Higher Flame guide is built around metabolic flexibility: the ability to move between carbohydrate and fat as fuel. It combines a time-limited eating window with plant compounds that the program describes as signals for the body’s own antioxidant systems. Fasting is no longer a fringe topic. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
